sentences: mid is (0+1)/2 which is 0, so a[0] is checked, low becomes 0, then next loop finds a[1].
The window has low 0 and high 1, so mid lands on 0, then after checking it moves closer to target.
Since low is less than high, the loop runs once, mid is 0, and one more step reaches index 1 exactly.
After first iteration low is 0 and high is 1 still, next mid becomes 0 again but now target is inside.
The target is at a[1], and with low 0 high 1, the midpoint 0 is below it, so next step hits it.
